notes:
- Create Custom Folder: the button is now just "Create", and the window closes after creating.
- New: TP_pipe > Project Utilities > User Pref Xfer (under Project Xfer). One window with a Save / Load switch.
- Save: pick View settings, This project's lists and/or Machine settings (all on by default). Saves into the project's "project settings" folder, and to your Google Drive "User Prefs" folder when Send to Google Drive is ticked (on by default when Drive is connected).
- Load: finds your saved prefs automatically (Google Drive, then this project, newest wins), or Browse… to pick a file. Load replaces your current settings for each ticked group. Folders that don't exist on this computer are skipped.
- Create Custom Folder redesigned: Category top left, Folder Name top right, then three windows: pick several assets/shots (Ctrl/Shift-click, All / None), tick one or more tasks (Root ticked by default), and a live preview. The Target dropdown is gone; the Target line at the bottom shows what's picked.
